layer_conflations.description: Conflating the abstract semantic witness TypedWitness_C (L3) with its concrete representation such as a trace certificate (L2).
layer_conflations.resolution: DEC-SEM-001 establishes TypedWitness_C as a semantic witness abstraction, treating trace certificates and Lean proof terms as distinct L2 realizations.

layer_conflations.description: Conflating type-preservation under OBL-D-001C (L4) with representable distinction preservation under OBL-D-001D (L4).
layer_conflations.resolution: P126 restricts OBL-D-001C to type-level preservation only, establishing that semantic representability is a distinct downstream property.

required_separations: Abstract witness validity must not be equated with execution trace success without a Realizes_C relation.
A well-typed projection must not be assumed to preserve relational distinction without a proved transport bridge.
